definitions.explanation: Having skill in using one's hands or managing practical tasks.
Able to handle many different things well.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{手先|てさき}が{器用|きよう}だ。
examples.english: She is good with her hands.

examples.japanese: {器用|きよう}に{折|お}り{紙|がみ}を{作|つく}る。
{彼|かれ}は{何|なん}でも{器用|きよう}にこなす。

notes:
{器用|きよう} describes skill with hands or general capability.

FORMS:
- {器用|きよう}な (attributive form)
- {器用|きよう}に (adverb: skillfully)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {手先|てさき}が{器用|きよう} (good with one's hands)
- {器用|きよう}にこなす (to handle skillfully)

ANTONYM:
- {不器用|ぶきよう} (clumsy, unskillful)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {器用|きよう}: handy, dexterous (hands)
- {上手|じょうず}: good at, skilled
- {巧|たく}み: skillful (craftsmanship)
